content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I'm attempting to configure a [product_name] ([article_no]) to communicate with [product_name] ([version_no]). Although the network appears to be set up correctly, I'm unable to establish a connection between them. My [product_name] has an integrated LAN port for web access. My question is: Do I need another type of module to connect to [product_name], or can I use the LAN port for this? Thank you for any assistance.
You might want to check this [company_name] website: Application examples for [product_name]. There’s a sample project for HMI communication starting from [product_name] ([version_no]) ([document]).

It's possible the issue lies within your PC's network settings. Try searching for the S7 network protocol and ensure your settings are correct. If they're not configured properly, resolving the connection could take a lot of time, as I've experienced myself. Sometimes, reading the manual helps, but forums like this are also quite helpful.

Thank you for your reply. I’m not sure what you mean by 'Please search for S7 network protocol.' I’ve assigned IP addresses to both devices and basic connectivity like ping and HTTP works, but communication with [product_name] isn't functioning.

Hi [user_name], On your PC running [product_name], make sure to select the correct communication port. In the 'Control Panel,' check the port under 'Set PG/PC Interface.' Also verify the port settings in the '[product_name] Loader' and ensure the 'activate' box is ticked. Hopefully, this will solve the issue. Regards, [user_name] Edit: Apologies [user_name], you mentioned this as well.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing uncertainty and technical obstacles when attempting to set up communication between [product_name] devices, even after confirming basic network connectivity. The main usability challenge is the unclear compatibility and configuration required for proper device communication. Multiple commenters emphasize the importance of correctly configuring communication ports and consulting documentation, highlighting a lack of intuitive setup guidance and troubleshooting support.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple and successful communication setup between [product_name] devices via the existing LAN port, without the need for extra modules or complex configuration steps.
